pages.text: $(l)Incident 0311: Mecha wrecked$()$(br2)Below 10%% health, the Golden Parachute threw the pilot clear. A frame destroyed outright throws the pilot too, with a knock to the glass; about half its modules survive. Next: a Glass Patch.
pages.title: Incident Report

pages.text: $(l)Incident 0451: Head left in a fire$()$(br2)The glass lost a point a second until it broke: a real death. Next time: fetch it with the Head Satchel at once, or fit a Heat Shield.
pages.title: Incident Report

pages.text: $(l)Incident 0517: Body died while away$()$(br2)A body left standing was killed and lay down as a corpse. Next: the Courier, then a Suture Kit. A Life Sign Monitor shows its health.$(br2)$(o)HR sends its condolences.$()
pages.title: Incident Report
